why: Whether an environment ACCEPTS a pre-release label is registry policy, decided at registration and configurable per environment. What a message may CARRY is a different question: a consumer reading a message stamped by a publisher whose environment permits rc labels must see the label rather than a warning about it. Build metadata is still refused, because SemVer ignores it for precedence - so two labels carrying different metadata compare equal while being different strings.
name: prerelease-semver-is-read
